<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Geopolitical Impact on Assets:</strong> Renewed US-Iran tensions have pushed Brent crude toward $76 per barrel, triggering a weaker opening for the rupee and weighing on domestic market sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic Indicators:</strong> While global volatility persists, 10-year bond yields are projected to soften to 6.64% as market participants adjust expectations regarding Federal Reserve policy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
